name: Big Bass Bonanza

features.name: Money symbols
features.description: Fish symbols carry random cash values.

features.name: Free spins with fisherman wilds
features.description: In free spins each fisherman wild collects every fish value on screen. Every fourth wild retriggers spins and raises the collect multiplier (2x, 3x, 10x).

review:
The game that started a series with dozens of sequels. The base game is a simple ten-liner, and the free spins are wonderfully easy to follow: land fish, land the fisherman, collect.

The 2,100x cap is low by modern standards, which is part of why it feels steadier than a lot of high-volatility games. The 96.71% RTP is one of the higher defaults in Pragmatic's range. Still the one to start with.
pros: Good entry point to the series
